preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(row, list) and all(isinstance(cell, int) and cell in {0, 1} for cell in row) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: The input `matrix` is a non-empty list of rows, where each row is a list of integers (0 or 1).
The matrix has at least one row and one column.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(row_num, int) and row_num >= 0 and row_num < len(matrix) for row_num in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each element in the returned list is a valid 0-based row index of the input matrix.

postconditions.expression: all(any(all(matrix[i][j] == matrix[k][j] for j in range(len(matrix[0]))) for k in range(i)) for i in return_value)
postconditions.description: For every row index `i` in the returned list, there exists at least one earlier row index `k` (k < i) such that `matrix[i]` is identical to `matrix[k]` (i.e., duplicate).

postconditions.expression: all(not any(all(matrix[i][j] == matrix[k][j] for j in range(len(matrix[0]))) for k in range(i)) for i in range(len(matrix)) if i not in return_value)
postconditions.description: For every row index `i` not in the returned list, there is no earlier row index `k` (k < i) such that `matrix[i]` is identical to `matrix[k]` (i.e., no duplicates).

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == sum(1 for i in range(1, len(matrix)) if any(all(matrix[i][j] == matrix[k][j] for j in range(len(matrix[0]))) for k in range(i)))
postconditions.description: The returned list contains exactly the row indices (excluding the first occurrence) of all duplicate rows in the matrix.
